name: safehome-ai-monorepo
description: SafeHome AI - Monorepo for Full-Stack Home Safety & Surveillance

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:python
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,python" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:python
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run build && npm run db:init
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
